player_facing_text: The large water jar resting on the center shelf is split cleanly from its lip to the base. Inside, the clay has dried out completely, fragmenting into pale, flaky layers that crumble softly to the touch. Nearby, a neat stack of coil-pots remains untouched on the lower shelf, their surfaces smooth and whole. The shed door stands open, allowing the outside air to drift in and mingle with the faint scent of earth and sunbaked clay.
